%% ================================================================
%  STEP 1 TEST: getHg9900ParameterList GYRO INPUT MAPPING
%  ================================================================
%
% Verify that external telemetry gyro axes:
%
%       Gyro_U -> gyro1
%       Gyro_V -> gyro2
%       Gyro_W -> gyro3
%
% map to the correct internal raw-structure fields.
%
% This tests the mapping generated by getHg9900ParameterList.
% It does NOT yet test decodeHg9900RawMux.
%

[paramNames, structNames] = ...
    MinAtrTmAnalysis.HG9900.getHg9900ParameterList();

% Normalize to strings so indexing/comparisons are simple.
paramNames  = string(paramNames);
structNames = string(structNames);

gyroAxes = ["U", "V", "W"];

%% Fields expected for each gyro
%
% Column 1:
%   Internal field suffix in s
%
% Column 2:
%   Text that should appear in the corresponding external parameter name.
%
% The important checks are:
%   1. gyro1/2/3 internal destination
%   2. U/V/W external source
%   3. Correct field type

fieldChecks = {
    "mux_tag",             "mux"
    "mux_word",            "mux"
    "status_status",       "Status"
    "readout_bit_status",  "Readout"
    "current_bit_status",  "Current"
    "dither_bit_status",   "Dither"
    "plc_bit_status",      "PLC"
    "status_id_counter",   "Status_ID_Counter"
    "lsb",                 "lsb"
    "msb",                 "msb"
    "checksum",            "checksum"
};


%% ================================================================
%  CHECK ALL THREE GYROS
%  ================================================================

fprintf('\n');
fprintf('============================================================\n');
fprintf('STEP 1: Checking HG9900 gyro parameter mapping\n');
fprintf('============================================================\n');

for gyroIdx = 1:3

    axisName = gyroAxes(gyroIdx);

    fprintf('\nChecking Gyro_%s -> gyro%d\n', ...
        axisName, gyroIdx);

    for fieldIdx = 1:size(fieldChecks,1)

        structSuffix = fieldChecks{fieldIdx,1};
        paramToken   = fieldChecks{fieldIdx,2};

        %% Expected internal structure name
        expectedStructName = sprintf( ...
            'HG9900_Raw_Data_Frame_Raptor_Counts_gyro%d_%s', ...
            gyroIdx, ...
            structSuffix);

        %% Find that destination in structNames
        idx = find(structNames == expectedStructName);

        assert(~isempty(idx), ...
            'Missing struct mapping: %s', ...
            expectedStructName);

        assert(numel(idx) == 1, ...
            'Duplicate struct mapping found for: %s', ...
            expectedStructName);

        mappedParamName = paramNames(idx);


        %% --------------------------------------------------------
        % Verify correct physical gyro axis
        % ---------------------------------------------------------

        expectedAxisText = "Gyro_" + axisName;

        assert(contains(mappedParamName, expectedAxisText, ...
            'IgnoreCase', true), ...
            ['Incorrect axis mapping for %s.\n' ...
             'Expected parameter containing: %s\n' ...
             'Actual parameter: %s'], ...
            expectedStructName, ...
            expectedAxisText, ...
            mappedParamName);


        %% --------------------------------------------------------
        % Verify correct parameter field
        % ---------------------------------------------------------

        assert(contains(mappedParamName, paramToken, ...
            'IgnoreCase', true), ...
            ['Incorrect field mapping for %s.\n' ...
             'Expected parameter containing: %s\n' ...
             'Actual parameter: %s'], ...
            expectedStructName, ...
            paramToken, ...
            mappedParamName);


        %% Print successful mapping
        fprintf('  PASS: %-28s -> %s\n', ...
            mappedParamName, ...
            expectedStructName);

    end
end


fprintf('\n');
fprintf('============================================================\n');
fprintf('STEP 1 GYRO MAPPING PASSED\n');
fprintf('============================================================\n\n');
